details:
PROJECT: AERIS is an interactive 2D Mars Mission Design Game developed using Scratch. Inspired by NASA's Perseverance rover and its MOXIE experiment, the game allows players to experience the challenges of planning and designing a robotic mission to Mars.

Players take on the role of mission engineers, responsible for configuring a rover by selecting different components and equipment. Each component has its own advantages and limitations, requiring players to make strategic engineering decisions. Players must balance important factors such as mass, power, mobility, reliability, communication and budget to prepare their rover for its mission. Once the design is complete, players proceed to a simulated Martian environment to carry out their objectives, including an oxygen-production experiment inspired by MOXIE.

The project aims to make space exploration and engineering more accessible and engaging for people of different ages. Through interactive gameplay, players can develop an understanding of resource management, engineering trade-offs and the challenges of exploring another planet. It also introduces the concept of In-Situ Resource Utilisation (ISRU), which involves using resources available on other celestial bodies rather than relying entirely on supplies transported from Earth.

What makes PROJECT: AERIS creative is its combination of educational gameplay, resource management and simplified engineering simulation. Instead of simply presenting information about Mars exploration, it allows players to actively make decisions and experience how those decisions influence mission performance.

The main development tool is Scratch, using its block-based programming system to implement the game's mechanics, interactive components, statistics and mission progression. The team also considered scientific accuracy, accessibility for different age groups, gameplay complexity, resource limitations and the practical constraints of developing a functional game within the competition timeframe.

Ultimately, PROJECT: AERIS hopes to inspire curiosity about space exploration and demonstrate how engineering, innovation and careful planning can contribute to the future of humanity beyond Earth.
dataRefs: NASA’s Oxygen-Generating Experiment MOXIE Completes Mars Mission
